labels.label: requested
labels.why: "`POST /tickets/:id/comments` ... answers 201 with the comment" and "a closed one answers 409"; reusing the existing error envelope only decides how the requested endpoint and its errors work.

labels.label: beyond
labels.why: The request asks only that "that agent is notified of the comment"; an outbox store with a retrying worker and unique keys adds delivery infrastructure that this request does not need.

labels.label: requested
labels.why: "Comments are kept like the rest of a ticket's state: they survive a restart of the service, and a data file written before this change keeps loading."

labels.label: implied
labels.why: Showing comments "oldest first" with distinct ids requires a deterministic order for simultaneous comment requests, and keeping the existing synchronous store ordering provides that without new mechanism.

labels.label: requested
labels.why: "An author is a non-empty name of at most 64 characters and a body a non-empty text of at most 2000 characters."

labels.label: beyond
labels.why: Audit entries are a new logging capability the request never mentions, and the worker failure handling exists only to support the extra outbox worker.
